entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who disguises himself as a prisoner to infiltrate the Cabal's Stronghold and find the Blackblade.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker disguised as a Cabal bounty hunter with an illusory scar.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer and planeswalker bound by a pact who raises an undead army of panther warriors as a diversion.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: The captain of the Weatherlight who arranges contact with the Urborg resistance and leads the diversion.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A time mage who has taken his spark back and who slows time so Gideon and Chandra can cross the Stronghold's defenses.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A metal being who guides the infiltration party and says he will consider joining the fight against Bolas.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A pyromancer who encourages Chandra before the mission.

entities.name: Raff
entities.description: An illusionist who casts a scar illusion on Chandra's face.

entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: A warrior aboard the Weatherlight who advises on disguises and watches the undead army.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: The Weatherlight's pilot who steers the ship toward the old battlefield.

entities.name: Arvad
entities.description: A vampire crew member of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Slimefoot
entities.description: A thallid stowaway who talks with Yavimaya spirits in Urborg and keeps its sprouts below.

entities.name: Sayrah
entities.description: A female panther warrior of the Urborg resistance who gives Jhoira a map and Cabal clothing.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: The demon ruler of the Cabal who appears in the fighting pit arena.

entities.name: Whisper
entities.description: A red-robed Cabal cleric who presides over the fighting pit and orders Gideon thrown in.

entities.name: Yargle
entities.description: A gigantic, living (not undead) creature made from a frog that ate a maggot Belzenlok made of Yar-Kul; it killed the panther warriors and attacks the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Yar-Kul
entities.description: A man Belzenlok transformed into a maggot.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker whom the group means to fight next.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: Karn's friend who gave him his spark and died.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A death cult led by Belzenlok that controls Urborg from its Stronghold.

entities.name: The Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship carrying the party into Urborg.

entities.name: The Blackblade
entities.description: A soul-draining sword said to be kept in the Cabal's treasure vaults, which the party seeks to kill Belzenlok.

entities.name: The Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact containing Onakke spirits that whisper to Liliana.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The swampy region of Dominaria full of ruins, undead and spirits where the Cabal's Stronghold stands.

entities.name: The Stronghold
entities.description: A partially rebuilt Phyrexian base built into a volcano's caldera, with a fighting pit and treasure vaults.

entities.name: The Fools' Tomb
aliases: monument to the fallen of the Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: A defaced monument to the Phyrexian invasion's fallen, as the Cabal calls it.

entities.name: Panther warriors
entities.description: A near-extinct people with feline heads; their dead are raised by Liliana.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest on Dominaria, whose essence is woven into Urborg's ground.

entities.name: Tolaria West
entities.description: Where a Cabal agent described the Stronghold.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane where Karn means to use the Sylex.

entities.name: The Sylex
entities.description: The weapon Karn plans to use against New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where Bolas did terrible things.

events.summary: The Weatherlight crosses into Urborg at dusk, and Jhoira reports the defaced monument she calls the Fools' Tomb.
events.quote: Apparently the Cabal calls it the Fools' Tomb.

events.summary: Jhoira explains the Urborg resistance's hidden base and that her owl has arranged a meeting.
events.quote: And the resistance has agreed to meet with us.

events.summary: Jhoira and Gideon meet resistance members including the panther warrior Sayrah, and ask for Cabal clothing and a map of past battle sites.
events.quote: First, the clothing of a Cabal scout or fighter, someone who would be hunting Urborg for captives to take to the Stronghold's fighting pit.

events.summary: Slimefoot converses with the spirits of Urborg, who say Yavimaya is woven into the ground and came to fight the demon.
events.quote: There is Yavimaya here, woven into the ground, from long ago. It came to fight .

events.summary: Raff casts an illusion that gives Chandra a sword scar for her Cabal bounty hunter disguise.
events.quote: Her skin puckered and pulled, creating a sword scar that ran from one side of her forehead to her jaw.

events.summary: Liliana says she wants her pact removed and Belzenlok in pieces.
events.quote: I want this pact off my body. I want Belzenlok in pieces.

events.summary: At dawn the party sees the Stronghold in the volcano's caldera, and Gideon, Chandra, Karn and Teferi set out on foot.
events.quote: Belzenlok has done some rebuilding,

events.summary: Teferi slows time around a grotto of spirits so the party can pass unseen.
events.quote: With a gesture Teferi slowed time around the spirits

events.summary: Teferi reveals he fought Bolas long ago and lost, and says he took his spark back to join the fight; Karn says he will consider the invitation.
events.quote: One of the reasons I took my spark back was to come with you.

events.summary: Karn says he will consider joining the fight against Bolas.
events.quote: I'll consider your invitation.

events.summary: Teferi casts a time-slowing spell around Gideon and Chandra, who walk through the Stronghold's frozen guards.
events.quote: Then he realized Teferi and Karn had seemed to freeze in place

events.summary: Gideon and Chandra climb the gate and cross traps past still guards.
events.quote: Careful to stay close together, they climbed the gate, the broad crosspieces making a good ladder.

events.summary: Liliana calls the dead of an old massacre site to raise an undead army as a diversion.
events.quote: And in the grass and reeds and brush below, the dead stirred.

events.summary: Gideon and Chandra enter the first hall, then Chandra chains Gideon as her prisoner when the time spell ends.
events.quote: Chandra fastened the chains around Gideon's wrists.

events.summary: The time spell ends and the Stronghold fills with noise as Cabal cultists run to the defenses.
events.quote: Slowly, the silence around them filled like water poured into a bowl.

events.summary: Liliana's panther liches pledge to follow the Weatherlight into battle.
events.quote: They'll follow the ship into battle.

events.summary: Yargle rises from the swamp, a living creature that killed all the panther warriors, and flings itself at the Weatherlight.
events.quote: Then Yargle roared and flung itself at the Weatherlight .

events.summary: Gideon and Chandra, delayed and without the expected diversion, are swept by a crowd into the fighting pit arena.
events.quote: Gideon tried to use his chains to brace her, but hands pushed him from behind and they stumbled into the arena with the crowd.

events.summary: Belzenlok appears in the arena to the cultists' chanting, and Whisper orders captives into the pit.
events.quote: Into the pit, for the glory of Belzenlok!

events.summary: Gideon tells Chandra to push him into the pit to buy time, and she does.
events.quote: Chandra shoved him, and Gideon pretended to stagger, then tumbled backward into the pit.

relations.quote: Jhoira. I'm Sayrah. You asked for our help.

relations.note: Whisper presides over the pit in Belzenlok's name
relations.quote: Into the pit, for the glory of Belzenlok!

relations.note: Yargle came from Belzenlok transforming Yar-Kul into a maggot
relations.quote: It was created when Belzenlok transformed some idiot called Yar-Kul into a maggot

relations.note: the panther liches say Yargle killed them all
relations.quote: It's what killed all of them.

relations.note: Teferi fought Bolas long ago and lost

relations.quote: I'm just not sure she knows it.

relations.note: Cultists chant his titles in the Stronghold
relations.quote: Demonlord, King of Urborg, Lord of the Wastes, Scion of Darkness

relations.note: she leads the undead army to break the Cabal's back
relations.quote: But if Liliana had her way, her army would also break the Cabal's back in Urborg.

relations.note: the Stronghold is built into the volcano on Urborg
relations.quote: It had been created as a Phyrexian base, then had been partially destroyed by an eruption when the Phyrexians were defeated.
